title: Active Particle Feedback Kinetic Arrest v0.3.2: When Noise Helps Escape Arrest in a Toy Active-Matter Surrogate
description: Claim-bounded public landing and metadata refresh for a reduced active-particle feedback surrogate archive. The package preserves the v0.3.1 integrated synthesis while strengthening public readability, GitHub Pages support, discovery metadata, claim-boundary presentation, and manifest consistency. It studies model-internal kinetic-arrest-like behavior, noise-assisted annealing, feedback-geometry dependence, frustration-boundary classification, rescue-stability regimes, and persistent hard-boundary behavior in tested toy-model settings. It does not claim experimental active-matter validation, material-design certification, biological/social-system validation, crowd-control or swarm-control deployment, public-policy applicability, or a universal kinetic-arrest theorem.
notes: License is source-defined Evaluation-Only Notice in the repository. Do not interpret repository archive DOI as a standalone peer-reviewed article DOI or validation certificate.
